levels.surface: الحسن بن علي بن عبد الله الكوفي

notes: «31 -» is the leading report number and «رحمه الله» a blessing; both left out
«حدثنا أبي» opens the chain as a bare relation to the compiler; «عن أبيه الحسن» and «عن جده عبد الله بن المغيرة» are one name each (rule 7)
The Imam is named only in the words after the chain («أنه سئل الصادق»), so he is the last link as imam_in_text (owner ruling 2); the passive «سئل» leaves the asker unnamed
